ios.desc:
FactJano is the ultimate fact and micro learning app for anyone who loves to learn and discover new things and interesting trivia. With a vast library of fascinating trivia and informative facts on various topics, you'll be amazed at the sheer breadth of knowledge at your fingertips.

Your knowledge is power so use the FactJano app to learn thousands of facinating facts and discover how truely astonishing the world is. Amaze your friends and family with your knowledge about the life and world.

You can learn thousands of facts about not just the old school categories but also the modern trending categories like ai, metaverse, startup, alien and more.

Key Features:

- Read amazing facts with descriptions and source links
- Cross verify a fact by AI
- Get a new fact of the day every day
- Personalized dashboard with facts based on your interests
- Easy-to-read design with customizable font options and data saver mode
- Listen or play facts to enhance your learning experience
- Earn coins and redeem premium features
